info.name: PorSca API v1
info.description: Repeatable backend contract checks. Run against a freshly seeded local or staging API. Never commit real tokens or webhook secrets.

exec: pm.test('product is created with authoritative stock', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.name).to.eql('Postman Managed Product'); pm.expect(data.category).to.eql('Beverage'); pm.expect(data.stock.quantity).to.eql(8); pm.expect(data.stock.status).to.eql('in_stock'); pm.environment.set('managed_product_id', data.id); pm.environment.set('managed_product_barcode', data.barcode); });

pm.test('product edit returns authoritative state', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.name).to.eql('Postman Managed Product XL'); pm.expect(data.barcode).to.eql('4800000000998'); pm.expect(data.price).to.eql(19900); pm.expect(data.stock.quantity).to.eql(11); });

pm.test('stock update returns authoritative state', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.stock.quantity).to.eql(9); pm.expect(data.stock.status).to.eql('in_stock'); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('cash_idempotency_key', 'postman-cash-' + Date.now());

pm.test('cash sale completes from server totals', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.status).to.eql('completed'); pm.expect(data.payment_method).to.eql('cash'); pm.expect(data.total_amount).to.eql(39800); pm.expect(data.cash_received).to.eql(40000); pm.expect(data.change_amount).to.eql(200); pm.expect(data.items[0].unit_price).to.eql(19900); pm.environment.set('cash_sale_id', data.id); });

pm.test('cash sale retry is idempotent', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.id).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('cash_sale_id'))); pm.expect(data.total_amount).to.eql(39800); pm.expect(data.change_amount).to.eql(200); });

pm.test('completed cash sale is queryable', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.id).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('cash_sale_id'))); pm.expect(data.status).to.eql('completed'); pm.expect(data.payment_method).to.eql('cash'); pm.expect(data.items.length).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('health is ok', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.status).to.eql('ok'); });

pm.test('products are returned with stock state', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const items = pm.response.json().data.items; pm.expect(items.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(items[0]).to.have.property('barcode'); pm.expect(items[0].stock).to.have.property('status'); });
const items = pm.response.json().data.items;
const rice = items.find(function (item) { return item.sku === 'RICE-001'; });
const coffee = items.find(function (item) { return item.sku === 'COFFEE-001'; });
const soap = items.find(function (item) { return item.sku === 'SOAP-001'; });
pm.expect(rice, 'seeded rice product').to.not.be.undefined; pm.expect(coffee, 'seeded coffee product').to.not.be.undefined; pm.expect(soap, 'seeded soap product').to.not.be.undefined;
pm.environment.set('product_id', rice.id); pm.environment.set('product_barcode', rice.barcode); pm.environment.set('out_of_stock_product_id', soap.id);

pm.test('name search finds coffee', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const items = pm.response.json().data.items; pm.expect(items.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(items[0].name).to.contain('Coffee'); });

pm.test('barcode lookup returns product', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.sku).to.eql('RICE-001'); pm.expect(data.barcode).to.eql(pm.environment.get('product_barcode')); });
pm.test('unknown barcode is explicit', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('not_found'); });

pm.test('inventory filter returns low and out states', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const items = pm.response.json().data.items; pm.expect(items.some(function (item) { return item.status === 'low_stock' && item.low_stock === true; })).to.eql(true); pm.expect(items.some(function (item) { return item.status === 'out_of_stock' && item.out_of_stock === true && item.quantity === 0; })).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('out-of-stock lookup is consistent', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.quantity).to.eql(0); pm.expect(data.status).to.eql('out_of_stock'); pm.expect(data.out_of_stock).to.eql(true); });

item.name: Sales - Checkout (creates QR Ph practice payment)

exec: pm.collectionVariables.set('idempotency_key', 'postman-' + Date.now());
pm.test('checkout is pending', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.status).to.eql('pending'); });
pm.environment.set('payment_id', pm.response.json().data.id);
pm.environment.set('provider_payment_id', pm.response.json().data.provider_payment_id);
pm.test('payment can be read', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.id).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('payment_id'))); });
const body = { event_id: 'evt-postman-' + Date.now(), type: 'payment.paid', payment_id: pm.environment.get('provider_payment_id'), status: 'paid' };
const raw = JSON.stringify(body);
pm.environment.set('webhook_body', raw);
pm.environment.set('webhook_signature', CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(raw, pm.environment.get('webhook_secret')).toString(CryptoJS.enc.Hex));

pm.test('webhook settles payment', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.payment.status).to.eql('paid'); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.payment.sale_id).to.not.be.null; });
pm.test('invalid webhook signature is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('duplicate webhook is ignored', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.duplicate).to.eql(true); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('failed_idempotency_key', 'postman-failed-' + Date.now());

pm.test('failed-state payment starts pending', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.status).to.eql('pending'); pm.environment.set('failed_payment_id', pm.response.json().data.id); pm.environment.set('failed_provider_payment_id', pm.response.json().data.provider_payment_id); });
const body = { event_id: 'evt-postman-failed-' + Date.now(), type: 'payment.failed', payment_id: pm.environment.get('failed_provider_payment_id'), status: 'failed' };
const raw = JSON.stringify(body);
pm.environment.set('failed_webhook_body', raw);
pm.environment.set('failed_webhook_signature', CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(raw, pm.environment.get('webhook_secret')).toString(CryptoJS.enc.Hex));

pm.test('failed webhook is non-destructive', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json().data.payment; pm.expect(data.status).to.eql('failed'); pm.expect(data.sale_id).to.be.null; });
pm.test('payment is paid', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.status).to.eql('paid'); });

pm.test('sales history includes completed sales', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const items = pm.response.json().data.items; pm.expect(items.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(items.some(function (item) { return item.id === Number(pm.environment.get('cash_sale_id')) && item.status === 'completed'; })).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('payment ledger exists', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.items.length).to.be.above(1); });

pm.test('cash sale ledger is queryable', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const items = pm.response.json().data.items; pm.expect(items.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(items[0].type).to.eql('cash_sale'); pm.expect(items[0].status).to.eql('completed'); pm.expect(items[0].amount).to.eql(39800); });
